measurement_procedure: Evaluate held-out chain, square, triangular, 3D, long-range, expander, random-regular, shuffled, uniform, Bell, and feasible topological controls; keep truth evaluator-only and report family-balanced recovery, distortion, status, dimension, stress, calibration, and abstention.
uncertainty_procedure: Use family-level bootstrap intervals and exact permutation checks; no family can be rescued by averaging with easier families.
statistical_analysis: Pass only if every geometric family clears recovery/distortion bounds, every control stays below false geometry, abstention stays bounded, and equivariance/stability pass.
mutation_plan: Construct an adversarial shuffled correlation matrix.
